exposure: percreta type of PAS on MRI/US
outcome: Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) diagnosis (confirmed by intraoperative diagnosis and/or histopathology)
surgical methods (cesarean hysterectomy vs. conservative surgery)
cohort: A total of 87 women suspected of Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) on ultrasound were included.
finding: MRI provides reliable diagnostic value for PAS, particularly when US findings are uncertain, and PAS identified via MRI/US was associated with increased blood loss and higher rates of cesarean hysterectomy for the percreta type.
mod_finding: PAS diagnosed via MRI/US was associated with more significant blood loss during cesarean section, and the percreta type of PAS identified on MRI/US was linked to significantly higher rates of cesarean hysterectomy compared to conservative surgery.
